name: lower_blackrock_spire
notes: DRAFT: hand-edited from the world database export of map 229 (tools/dungeongen/testdata/map229). The boss order is the usual clear order; every position is a spawn row. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.

The map-229 box split (LBRS x <= 30, UBRS x >= 30) cuts through the shared instance: the draft's 11 packs at z 106-111 (Blackhand Elite/Assassin/Iron Guard, Rage Talon Captain/Dragon Guard/Fire Tongue, two Rage Talon Dragonspawn) are the western half of UBRS's Rookery/Blackhand's Command, reached only by walking through the UBRS side; they are out of this plan (UBRS's own box starts at x 30 and misses them too).

Rares are members, not a skip list: 9217 Spirestone Lord Magus with a Warlord, 9218 Battle Lord, 9718 Ghok Bashguud standing on a Warlord pack, 10376 Crystal Fang with Spire Spiders. 9219 Spirestone Butcher patrols a 180 yd loop through the ogre room and is a patrol block, not a member.
Mor Grayhoof (16080) and his trigger 16044 stand at War Master Voone's spot but belong to the brazier summoning event, not to a pull; both are skipped.

Patrols: 15 spawns walk creature_movement paths (Quartermaster Zigris himself 61 yd, three Bloodaxe Veterans 242-307 yd with 29 yd of z, two Firebrand Legionnaires 529 yd, two Spirestone rares/mobs 180 yd, the Spire Spider 188 yd, Rage Talon Captain 176 yd, Smolderthorn Mystic/Shadow Priest, two Bloodaxe Raiders). Each pull they cross carries a patrol block with an estimated period (PeriodEstimate), so the agent locates them; the run leader's rows carry no patrol.
Needs: Urok Doomhowl is summoned with the Challenge to Urok (GO_CHALLENGE_UROK) at the ogre room.
Needs: Halycon and Gizrul the Slavener (summoned); Gizrul (10268) has no spawn row.
Needs: the Doors (GO_DOORS) and the Rookery eggs (GO_ROOKERY_EGG) are UBRS-side; no door, lever or key step is needed for the seven bosses.
LBRS and UBRS share map 229; this plan is the lower half. UBRS is the raid plan upper_blackrock_spire.
